title: Contain Virus
description: Contain the virus by building walls around infected regions to prevent them from spreading to uninfected cells.
pseudocode:
1. Find all connected components of viruses
2. For each region, calculate the wall cost to contain and count the threats to uninfected cells
3. Select the region that threatens the most uninfected cells
4. Build walls around it and spread the remaining viruses

steps.note: Region 1 needs 4 walls and threatens 3 empty cells. Region 2 needs 4 walls and threatens 4 empty cells.
Region 2 is chosen to be contained because it threatens more cells.
Building walls around Region 2 and spreading Region 1 to neighbors.
